amendment: V4 prospectively failed only hash prover-RSS trial interval coverage (72% versus 80%); V5 predeclares a training-only absolute-byte interval from leave-one-training-program-out signed RSS residuals. V4 held-out observations motivate this independent new study but are never used as V5 fit or calibration inputs.
artifact_retention_policy: Fail before native build/proof phase if host volume has under 8 GiB available. Retain V4 raw cohort and all V5 package/proof evidence; no opportunistic deletion during a frozen corpus.
chip_manifest_policy: every direct-chip package must carry s31-component-manifest-direct-chip-v2 with exactly one chip_call at call_id 0, bound in sealed native key and package manifest
external_anchor_policy: Before first native build, commit design/s31/measurements/language/whole-prover-cost-v5-protocol-freeze.json containing schema, aware UTC timestamp, full protocol SHA, source/engine/compiler/tool pins; externally record its full commit SHA and protocol SHA in a timestamped message. Pass both to every build/prove phase. After training and before any held-out build, similarly commit whole-prover-cost-v5-model-freeze.json containing full model SHA, training corpus SHA, protocol SHA and timestamp; externally record its full commit SHA and model SHA. Runner requires committed anchor bytes at those ancestor commits, current bytes equality, and model anchor descendant of protocol anchor. CLI arguments or an uncommitted draft file alone are insufficient proof of chronology.

features.chip_fri_domain_rows: for direct-chip only, maximum 2^trace_log_size over generated typed-manifest components; captures the largest FRI tier
features.chip_trace_cells: for direct-chip only, sum over generated typed-manifest components of (2^trace_log_size) * (base_trace_columns + interaction_trace_columns); captures total committed AIR trace work
features.hash_work: 1 + raw blake_g rows; used for opaque gate hash prove stage

host_policy: one named host and one compiler fingerprint for every train/validation package; no cross-host reliability claim
model: V4 expected-wall and proof-byte point/interval formulas unchanged. RSS point fit remains positive affine for arithmetic/direct chip and log-linear for hash/fixed width. RSS trial interval uses a symmetric absolute-byte radius calibrated only from V5 training programs left out of their own fit.
point_target: per-program arithmetic mean of 100 fresh-process prover-plus-native-verifier wall times; a sampling estimate of expected wall under the pinned host/process policy, distinct from v3.1 program median
pow_variance: Keep interaction and FRI PoW separate where timers expose them; hash prove includes opaque PoW. Report stage means, medians, p90, CV, and process-wall variance. Never interpret fixed 26-bit PoW as deterministic. Use 100 independent transcript-dependent assignments/program.
prebuild_admission_amendment: Before any V5 native build or timing, static frontend elaboration showed i128 quotient+remainder would expose 16 u16 words, above the current eight-word public ABI limit. The train i128 program now publishes quotient only and the held-out i128 program publishes remainder only; each exposes eight words. No V5 native observation existed.
rss_interval: For each V5 training program j, fit its family RSS point model on all other training programs; for each of its 100 trials compute observed RSS bytes minus the out-of-fold predicted center. Let radius_j=max(abs(q05 signed residual),abs(q95 signed residual)). The full-training model interval is [max(0,center-max_j radius_j), center+max_j radius_j]. No held-out residual can alter this radius.
selection_policy: Automatic lowering stays disabled even after a local pass; independent source revision, host transfer, cached setup, paired lowering comparisons, and proof soundness equivalence remain separate prerequisites
source_pin_policy: Before the first native V5 build, replace null source/engine/compiler digests with exact integrated commits and compiler SHA-256, then freeze protocol SHA and reject any compiler change across all builds/trials.
split_policy: All V5 train and held-out source bytes and assignment values are newly generated, disjoint within V5 and checked against earlier V4 generated sources/assignments at static admission. Fit only V5 train; commit and externally record exact serialized model SHA before any V5 held-out package build. Reject duplicate source/assignment digests and require exact host/compiler/tool/protocol/profile/FRI match. Separate build/prove phases; prove checks committed anchors and build-inventory protocol and model SHA before native work.
tool_pin_policy: Before first V5 native build, pin a sorted explicit inventory of all S31 benchmark and frontend Python paths plus their aggregate SHA-256. Runner and publisher require the exact path inventory and bytes; later added files require replay on the pinned checkout, not silent omission.
wall_interval: For each training program, fit the full stage model on all other training programs, predict its expected wall, and collect every observed trial-wall / out-of-fold prediction ratio. Use pooled 5th and 95th percentile ratios as the prospective per-trial interval around the full-training expected-wall prediction. This interval is empirical and has no guaranteed tail coverage.
